headline: Good coffee. Great craic.
subline: A mobile coffee trailer rolling out of Chester, pouring proper coffee at markets, festivals, weddings and wherever you need a warm welcome in the North West.
story: Éire is Irish for Ireland, and it is how we like to serve: unhurried, generous and with a bit of chat on the side. One trailer, carefully made coffee and the sort of welcome you would get at a kitchen table back home. Find us at a stop near you, or ask us to pull up at your event.

values.title: Good coffee
values.text: Carefully pulled espresso and a short, honest menu. We would rather do a few things properly than a lot of things quickly.

values.title: Great craic
values.text: Conversation is part of the order. Stop, say hello and stay a while. Nobody gets rushed at our hatch.

values.title: Céad míle fáilte
values.text: A hundred thousand welcomes. Whether you are a regular, a first-timer or a wedding party of one hundred, there is always room.
